title: Yumira Hub
features:
Auto Farm gathers pollen in the selected field; Auto Convert returns to the hive at the chosen capacity; Auto Micro Converter uses Micro-Converters; Auto Convert Balloon converts on a timer; Smart Auto Crosshair builds
  x10 Precision and holds a target for instant conversion; Auto Build Sprinkler places sprinklers; Auto Dig digs continuously; Auto Speed maintains movement speed; Smart Field Booster follows boosted fields; Auto Natural
  Sprout farms sprouts and collects rewards; Catch Star Shower and Catch Coconut collect falling marks; Collect Duped Token gathers duplicated tokens; Priority Collectibles grabs selected tokens first; Auto Bubble
  produces bubbles; Face With Bubble faces nearby bubbles; Only Bubble When Pop Star limits bubbles to Pop Star; Auto Bloom activates Blooms; Auto Petal spawns and collects petals; Auto Leaves, Sparkles, Fireflies, and
  Balloon farming collect their respective field rewards; Auto Puffshroom hunts matching puffshrooms; Auto Ant, Vicious Bee, Windy Bee, Coconut Crab, King Beetle, Tunnel Bear, Stump Snail, Mondo Chick, Commando Chick,
  Ladybug, Rhino Beetle, Spider, Werewolf, Scorpion, and Mantis handle combat automatically; Smart Boss Scheduler runs ready bosses by priority; Auto Quest completes selected NPC objectives; Auto Accept accepts and turns
  in quests; Auto Planter places, rotates, grows, and collects configured planters; Smart Planter Mode manages nectar using selected planters and presets; Auto Robo Bear handles challenge rounds, bees, quests, upgrades,
  rewards, passes, and dodging; Auto Memory Match plays selected machines; Auto Use Toys activates ready cooldown toys; Auto Use Buffs consumes selected inventory buffs; Auto Blender repeatedly crafts recipes; Auto
  Sticker Printer prints hourly; Promo tools redeem entered or known codes; Auto Badge Claim claims completed badge tiers; and the Console displays, clears, and copies live automation logs.
